# wip

> wip is a proposed version control system built on jj's change model with cryptographic read scopes: sealed changes, per-path access, universal undo, full git coexistence. This site is a design RFC. There is no code yet; the design is published for hostile review.

Key facts: access control is key wrapping, not server policy. Sealed changes can be revealed later with the same hash. The tool is free forever; the cryptography is never a paywall. Apache-2.0 when there is code.

## Docs

- [Home](https://wip-scm.org/): problem, six design pillars, kill list, hostile review status
- [The full RFC](https://wip-scm.org/rfc): complete system argument, design decisions, all nine kill risks
- [Hostile review: the system](https://wip-scm.org/antagonist.md)
